result.detail: Two recorded decisions, both detailed in the artifacts: (1) the grant uses the masked priority encoder that the microarchitecture names as equivalent, instead of the explicit loop, which keeps index widths constant for lint; (2) the pointer is encoded from the rotated grant. Not delivered: the formal_spec (.sby) files and rr_arbiter_tb_fail.v, so the formal-proof part of interface-spec section 6 is still open and needs a follow-up task. The testbench uses # delays and $error, so it assumes Icarus with SystemVerilog severity tasks enabled, or Verilator with --timing. The testbench has no `timescale, because the RTL has none and mixing them would trigger Verilator TIMESCALEMOD. Independent review is still required; nothing here is reviewed or approved.
